top.title: The Glenlivet Captures the Sun-Soaked Spirit of Provence in New Limited Edition

The expression won a Gold medal at the 2026 Scotch Whisky Masters and features flavor notes of orchard fruits, floral complexity, and spice. The release represents the brand's innovation within the single malt category while maintaining its Scottish heritage.

top.title: Beta Bionics Announces Pricing of Public Offering of Common Stock and Pre-Funded Warrants
top.summary: Beta Bionics (Nasdaq: BBNX) announced a public offering of 7.65 million shares at $17.25 per share, along with pre-funded warrants, expected to raise $150 million in gross proceeds. The company plans to use the funds for commercialization of its Mint patch pump, manufacturing expansion, R&D, and clinical development. The offering is expected to close on September 17, 2026.

top.title: SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Beta Bionics, Inc. Sued for Securities Law Violations; Investors Should Contact Block & Leviton To Learn How They Might Recover Their Losses
top.summary: Beta Bionics, Inc. faces a securities fraud lawsuit for allegedly misleading investors about the safety of its iLet Bionic Pancreas device. The company downplayed FDA concerns about over 18,000 unreported complaints, characterizing them as 'benign' while the FDA warning letter later contradicted these claims. The stock fell from $31.99 to under $13 per share between July 2025 and February 2026. Eligible investors who purchased shares during this period may recover losses.

top.title: ROSEN, TRUSTED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Beta Bionics, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - BBNX
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed a class action lawsuit against Beta Bionics, Inc. (NASDAQ: BBNX) on behalf of investors who purchased common stock between July 30, 2025 and February 24, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that Beta Bionics made materially false and misleading statements about its iLet Bionic Pancreas insulin pump, which the FDA found to be malfunctioning and dosing patients with dangerously high insulin levels. The company allegedly failed to disclose thousands of complaints and hundreds of life-threatening events to the FDA. The deadline for investors to serve as lead plaintiff is November 3, 2026.

top.title: AEVEX Corp. Notice of October 20, 2026 Application Deadline for Class Action Lawsuit - Contact Lewis Kahn, Esq. at Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC, Before Application Deadline
top.summary: A class action securities lawsuit has been filed against AEVEX Corp. alleging that the company and its executives concealed a pre-arranged plan with Madison and underwriters to prematurely override the 180-day post-IPO lock-up agreement. The alleged scheme allowed Madison to conduct a secondary public offering (SPO) shortly after the April 2026 IPO, generating over $200 million for Madison and $8+ million in fees for underwriters. Investors who purchased shares between April 17 and June 4, 2026 can join the lawsuit with an October 20, 2026 deadline to request lead plaintiff status.

top.title: AEVEX Corp. (AVEX) Class Action Lawsuit Seeks Recovery for Investors; October 20, 2026, Deadline - Contact Kessler Topaz Meltzer & Check, LLP
top.summary: A securities fraud class action lawsuit has been filed against AEVEX Corp. (NYSE: AVEX) alleging material misstatements regarding a pre-arranged secondary public offering shortly after its April 2026 IPO. The company's stock fell approximately 23% following disclosures in early June 2026 that Madison Dearborn Partners waived lock-up restrictions to sell shares, with all $207.9 million in SPO proceeds going to the private equity firm rather than the company. Investors have until October 20, 2026, to file for lead plaintiff status.

top.title: Deadline Alert: Aevex Corp. (AVEX) Shareholders Who Lost Money Urged To Contact Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP About Securities Fraud Lawsuit
top.summary: Aevex Corp. shareholders who purchased securities between April 14-June 4, 2026 are urged to file lead plaintiff motions by October 20, 2026 in a class action lawsuit. The complaint alleges the company failed to disclose a pre-arranged plan between controlling shareholder Madison Dearborn Partners and underwriters to waive the 180-day lock-up period, enabling a secondary offering that benefited only Madison while generating zero proceeds for Aevex. The stock fell 15.98% on June 2 and an additional 7.07% on June 5 following the announcements.

top.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges AEVEX Corp. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against AEVEX Corp. alleging that IPO offering documents were materially false and misleading. Investors who purchased AEVEX stock during the IPO or between April 17 and June 4, 2026, are encouraged to join the case.

top.title: Immunotherapy Drugs Market 2026: Precision Medicine, Next-Generation Biologics and Expanding Cancer Indications Fuel Growth Opportunities
top.summary: The global immunotherapy drugs market is experiencing significant growth driven by advances in biotechnology, rising demand for targeted treatments, and expanding therapeutic applications across cancer, autoimmune, and inflammatory diseases. Key growth factors include increasing disease burden, robust drug pipelines, personalized medicine adoption, and combination therapy development. The Americas and Europe remain dominant markets, while Asia-Pacific is emerging as a high-growth region. Major pharmaceutical and biotech companies are increasing R&D investments and collaboration to accelerate innovation.

top.summary: Space42 and Viasat have signed a binding agreement to establish Equatys, a neutral shared space and ground infrastructure platform for Direct-to-Device (D2D) and advanced Mobile Satellite Service (MSS) connectivity.
